provenance: Deterministic simulated ESP32-style playthroughs. No humans, physical ESP32 signals, or live database records are included.

assumptions.randomizedPace: Uniformly sampled among slow, medium, and fast after the medium warm-up cycle.
assumptions.playerVariation: Each simulated participant receives a distinct latent accuracy and reaction-time profile.
outcomeFactors: Longer sequences and faster previews reduce simulated clear probability.
Remaining lives, previous misses, reaction time, and prior pace also influence simulated outcomes.
assumptions.trainingSplit: The trainer holds out whole participant codes so rounds from the same simulated player do not appear in both training and evaluation.
